title: sdks-unify-auth-retries-streaming-parity-ergonomics-v1.203.0
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth and retries, stabilize streaming ergonomics, and bump client versions to v1.203.0. Changes include a single auth token refresh surface across languages, consistent exponential-backoff retry logic with jitter, consolidated streaming events API with deterministic close semantics, and small ergonomics improvements (context manager for Python, async iterator ergonomics for TS, improved error types for Go). Checklist: - [x] Unify auth surface (token refresh + credentials chaining) - [x] Implement shared retry policy and configs - [x] Stabilize streaming API and update examples - [x] Add cross-SDK integration tests and e2e harness - [x] Bump SDK package versions and changelogs - [x] Update docs snippets and quickstarts Related work: ENG-2034, ENG-2077. This PR is a coordinated cross-repo change touching sdk-python, sdk-typescript, sdk-go. See commits for per-repo details and small compatibility notes for consumers.

review_comments: Ben Carter: Nice work unifying the auth surface. Two ask items: (1) add a short migration note for users who implemented custom token refresh, (2) ensure the TS streaming iterator closes underlying socket on early return.
Aisha Patel: Addressed both items. Added migration section to docs/sdk/upgrade_guide.md and added explicit close() in ts streaming iterator. PTAL.
Lena Zhao: Tests look good. Found intermittent flakiness in the Go streaming test on linux-02, added a small backoff in test harness. Approved after CI passes.
Mateo Ruiz: Confirmed retry semantics match the server-side idempotency expectations. Left a small comment about default max retries.
ci_log_summary: CI matrix: python 3.10/3.11, node 16/18, go 1.20; linting fixed on first run; flaky test in go streaming retried and passed; integration e2e passed against staging. All checks green on re-run.
release_notes: Bump SDKs to v1.203.0: unified auth + auto-refresh across Python/TS/Go; consistent retry/backoff policy with jitter; stabilized streaming API and improved ergonomics (Python context manager, TS async iterator close, clearer Go error types); migration notes added in docs/sdk/upgrade_guide.md.
notes_for_consumers: Migration: If you implement a custom token refresher, implement the TokenProvider interface in each language (examples in docs). Default retry policy changed: default max_retries is now 5 with exp backoff+full jitter; you can override via client.retry.set_policy(...). Streaming: close() or 'with' (Python) / for await...finally (TS) recommended to ensure proper shutdown. See docs for exact code snippets.
